# QS-CFW-1140-78 - Quality specification - axle hub CFW-1140-78 (4140)  
Revision: Rev E · Plant: P1 · Parts: CFW-1140-78  
This revision supersedes Rev D.

Scope
- Defines material and dimensional quality requirements for axle hub CFW-1140-78 (CFW-1140-78) produced in Plant P1. Applies to forged and heat-treated parts delivered for final machining and assembly.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 4140 per procurement specification | Verify heat lot traceability on packing |
| Hardness | 27-32 HRC | Hardness is measured on finished, machined surface |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.08 mm | Applies to specified bore feature on drawing for CFW-1140-78 |
| Maximum forging weight | 74.6 kg | Weigh part after forging and cleaning; do not exceed for press capacity |

Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect for surface discontinuities, laps, and cold shuts. Reject parts with visible forging defects that compromise fit or function.  
- Dimensional: Measure bore diameter using appropriate gauge or CMM; verify conformance to bore diameter tolerance ±0.08 mm. Record measured values on inspection record.  
- Hardness: Perform hardness testing on finished, machined surface using Rockwell method; report values and ensure they fall within 27-32 HRC. Calibrate hardness tester per plant calibration program.  
- Weight: Weigh forgings after cleaning and verify maximum forging weight 74.6 kg is not exceeded for press and handling constraints.

Nonconformance handling
- Isolate nonconforming parts and tag to prevent use. Create nonconformance record and include material heat lot and forging information.  
- For dimensional or hardness failures, evaluate cause (process, heat treat, machining) and disposition (rework, reheat, or scrap) based on engineering review.  
- Document corrective actions and prevent recurrence. Retain inspection records with part traceability for audit and customer review.
